Task lifecycle visibility - wave 2: the correctness spine of the graph

content.value: Wave 1 made the thought states VISIBLE - the substrate, the glyphs, the design language on every rendering surface. This wave makes the state graph CORRECT: every state change is legal-or-refused, dead thought states cannot lie on the board, and the claim seam tells the truth about what 'blocked' means. Visibility without enforced legality is a graph held together by convention. This wave closes that gap.

TASK LIFECYCLE VISIBILITY - the thought states (considering / researching / open / considered) and the state graph need to be legible and correct end to end. Advance this epic: fix the highest-value lifecycle/visibility defects with protective tests, and name the shortest path to seal. Root task: task-lifecycle-visibility-epic.

blocks.text: Where wave 1 left the epic (reconciled at L1, 2026-07-21)

content.value: Wave 1 filed 8 slices (tlv-s1..s8) plus a backlog. Ground truth from the ledger and git:

items.value: S1 substrate - DONE and LIVE. Commit f08c48ec7 grew lifecycle_status 5->7; validation.ex:23 now holds ~w(open in_progress blocked done cancelled considering researching). DB CHECK migrations + engagement-map validation shipped with it.
S2 tokens-manifest chain - DONE (design/tokens.json + Go life consts + goldens).
S3 status-manifest / papers-email chain - DONE (violet tone, thought board columns in paper/email surfaces).
S4 web + @barkpark/react vocab + fail-open - DONE.
S5 Studio board + chat fail-open - OPEN. Touches barkpark_web/live/studio - CEDED to the studio-owning wave this cycle per lead fence.
S6 engagement honesty lease + brief card + create-receipt echo - OPEN, UNBUILT. ttl_sweeper.ex has only the lease sweep; no second engagement sweep exists.
S7 transition-legality gate + sanctioned stage verb - OPEN, UNBUILT. No transitions.ex; no POST /v1/tasks/:doc_id/stage; no task.stage manifest verb.
S8 epic-cycle walks its own graph (Front B) - OPEN. Round-3 capstone; waits on S5/S6/S7. Not this wave.
Backlog tlv-bl-* (8 items) + spd-b24 (blocked is not a true fence) - OPEN.

content.value: Everything shipped is RENDERING. Nothing shipped is ENFORCEMENT. Today any actor can PATCH a task from any lifecycle to almost any other via /v1/data/mutate; a crashed cycle leaves a task stuck in 'researching' forever with no reaper; and 'blocked' hides a task from ready yet is still directly claimable. The graph is drawn but not defended. That is exactly the 'correct end to end' half the wish asks for.

blocks.text: Direction for this wave: land the correctness spine, in our fence

content.value: Three keystones plus cheap disjoint defects, all inside the tasks/ + CLI + tasks-API lane. Studio surfaces are ceded to their wave; web/react/JS rendering is done or deferred backlog.

items.value: S7 - the transition-legality gate + one sanctioned stage verb. A pure Barkpark.Tasks.Transitions.legal?/2 table (new file, fully in-fence) is the single source of legality. Every patch-driven lifecycle change is legal-or-refused at the write seam; engine primitives (close/claim/move/sweeper raw update_all) bypass by construction. One generic verb - bp task stage <id> <state> [--object research|build] [--note] -> POST /v1/tasks/:doc_id/stage - writes/clears the engagement map and emits additive task.staged. The keystone: it turns the graph from convention into enforced law.

S6 - the engagement honesty lease. A second TtlSweeper sweep (same module, same advisory-lock family, NO epoch machinery): researching with a stale engagement.ts lapses to considering; considering with a stale ts clears its engagement. Emits additive task.engagement_lapsed. Plus the additive 14th brief-card key (engagement, omit-when-absent) and the create-receipt echoing the real lifecycle_status so births-as-considering are visible. Makes the thought states TRUTHFUL.

spd-b24 - rule on 'blocked is not a true fence'. Today ~w(open blocked) makes a blocked task directly claimable; blocked only hides it from ready/next. Decide intended-soft (document + test the invariant) vs true blocking primitive (bigger blast radius). Resolve with a protective test either way.

Cheap disjoint defects: tlv-bl-tasks-ls-offset-broken (server ignores offset - every page repeats page 0; --all self-aborts) and tlv-bl-ready-allowlist-consolidation (queue.ex:35 and claim.ex:26 duplicate ~w(open blocked) - one source of truth).

content.value: Every fix ships a protective test proven able to fail by mutation. Builders default to fable; reserve opus only for the transition gate if its correctness proves subtle.

blocks.text: The state graph this wave defends (charter D7)

content.value: Legal via patch/stage: considering<->researching; considering|researching->open|cancelled; open->considering|blocked|cancelled; blocked->open|cancelled; in_progress->blocked|open; done->open; cancelled->open; no-op same->same. REFUSED via patch: any->done, any->in_progress (must use close/claim verbs), done|cancelled->considering|researching. A forged 'done' has real teeth - cascade_unblock_dependents fires on done - so refusing it at the patch door is correctness. done->open stays legal because the documented false-done reopen recipe depends on it.

Rival A - Breadth of visibility + cheap wins: finish rendering, fix pagination, kill dead vocab copies, add the JS drift gate, brief card, ready-allowlist, prime-chip. Closes more tasks. LOST because (1) Studio - the primary visibility surface - is ceded to another wave this cycle, gutting breadth's payoff; and (2) it leaves the graph UNENFORCED and thought states still able to LIE, the largest correctness hole and the exact thing 'correct end to end' names.

Rival B - Chase the whole remaining wave-1 roster (S5+S6+S7) in one wave. LOST on fence collision: S5 is board_live + Studio chat, explicitly owned by another wave this cycle; grabbing it invites a two-session clobber on studio LiveView.

WINNER - the correctness spine (S6 + S7 + spd-b24 + two cheap defects). Won because it is fully inside our tasks/ + CLI fence with zero studio overlap; it is the deepest lever on the wish's own words - an enforced, honest graph is what 'correct' means; and it is the shortest genuine path to seal, since S5 lands in parallel elsewhere and only S8 then remains.

Survey digest - what the 13 reports established (L1)

items.value: Writer-seam is REACHABLE - the sharpest attack is REFUTED. felix-pristine never touched content/writer.ex (git log: last touch 65da9f64d, unrelated pt-w1, already on main); no open PR touches it; no merge-freeze concept ties to it. prev_doc is in scope at writer.ex:126 (do_create_document) and :553 (do_upsert_document), before Document.changeset/Repo.update. S7 enforces at writer.ex - no need to fall back to a tasks-side seam.

Engine primitives bypass by construction. 5 sites write lifecycle_status via raw Repo.update_all - close.ex:271, close.ex:437 (cascade_unblock_dependents!), ttl_sweeper.ex:284, claim.ex:316, release.ex:137 - none route through Content.Writer or Tasks.Validation. move/compactor/fence touch rows but never write lifecycle_status; judge.ex never touches the DB. A Writer-seam gate excludes every engine write automatically. No Barkpark.Tasks.Transitions module exists - S7 is greenfield.

The mutate door already has TWO merged guards on origin/main: ensure_task_close_is_cas/5 (cch-w1, #5309/515f14fdd) refuses a blind patch INTO terminal (done|cancelled|blocked, mutations.ex:402) unless ifRevisionID is present; ensure_claim_not_dropped/4 (cch-w2, #5435/a893c3821) refuses erasing an existing claim. Both wired at mutations.ex 177/178, 268/269, 312/313, 341/342. The ledger shows these tasks in_progress but git is truth - they are LIVE.

GAPS S7 must NEWLY close (the guard inspects the TARGET status only, never the SOURCE): any->in_progress is UNGUARDED (in_progress is not in the terminal set); done->considering / done->open / cancelled->researching are ALL UNGUARDED; a fresh create with lifecycle_status=done bypasses everything (cch-w3, still open/unbuilt, 0/3). The wish's 'REFUSED via patch: any->in_progress' and 'done|cancelled->considering|researching' have ZERO coverage today.

bp task claim is NOT broken. The lead's live finding is STALE/DEAD - fixed 5+ weeks ago (0829d68a6, confirmed ancestor of HEAD). A live --dry-run repro builds POST /v1/tasks/<id>/claim with worker in body; all 136 manifest commands have resolvable placeholders. Do NOT cut a claim-fix slice.

spd-b24's premise is HALF-WRONG at L1: 'blocked' does NOT hide a task from ready today - a live blocked task (pds-w1-crown-proof) appears in bp task ready. Real gating is blocks-edges + content.dependencies, not the lifecycle label; blocked IS directly claimable via the open|blocked allowlist. Recommendation: intended-soft (document + protective-test the current open/blocked symmetry); a true blocking primitive is a deeper cross-surface (board.ex + ceded S5) change for after S7.

ready-allowlist duplication is 4 copies, not 2: queue.ex:35 (attr), claim.ex:26 (attr, used in a guard at :158), queue.ex:91 (raw SQL fragment IN ('open','blocked')), board.ex:1001 (function-guard literal). Zero copies in Go/JS (they render server-resolved strings). The filed tlv-bl-ready-allowlist-consolidation names only 2 - underscoped. Fix stays attribute-shaped (Elixir guards need compile-time literals): @claimable_statuses derived from a new Validation.claimable_statuses/0, mirroring lifecycle_statuses/0.

The pagination bug is real and TWO-layered: GET /v1/tasks (TasksController.index/2, tasks_controller.ex:227-263) never reads or applies offset (base query has limit but no offset; params['offset'] is never referenced), AND the task.ls manifest (plugins/tasks.ex) declares no offset flag. task.ready is the exact working template (manifest offset flag + ready/2 parse/clamp/apply). doc.query pages correctly. The fix must touch BOTH tasks_controller.ex and plugins/tasks.ex.

S6 substrate is fully landed: engagement validated as an optional top-level map (validation.ex:117, claim-map precedent, no epochs); desk 'thinking' chip (schema.ex:78, in [considering,researching]); 'discarded' resolution option (schema.ex:565, UNENFORCED). S6 build = a SECOND sweep in ttl_sweeper.ex reusing the advisory-lock + select-then-recheck + CAS-rev pattern, NO epoch machinery, lapsing researching->considering + clearing stale engagement, emitting task.engagement_lapsed, new config key task_engagement_ttl_seconds (default 900). tlv-s6 already carries this recipe verbatim.

Test harness: mix test is safe + fast on this box (~3s for a DataCase file against the already-live Postgres); ONLY mix phx.server OOMs, never mix test. No shared task fixture exists - mk_task!/3 is copy-pasted across 22+ files. considering/researching appear in NO engine code yet; S6/S7 tests will be the FIRST committed tests that create those rows.
writer.ex prev_doc sites (do_create:118/126, do_upsert:545/553) and validate_task_kind ordering (runs on attrs BEFORE prev_doc fetch) - FOUND.
Engine bypass set across all 8 tasks/ files (which write lifecycle_status vs which only touch the row) - FOUND.
cch-w1/w2 merged guard code, line numbers, wiring, terminal set, and the create/createIfNotExists structural exemption - FOUND (git show origin/main).
ttl_sweeper full anatomy (advisory lock hashtext('task:'||id), still_expired? recheck, CAS-rev update_all, config key + env override, plugin oban_crontab tuple) - FOUND.
engagement-map validation (validation.ex:117), desk thought chip (schema.ex:78), resolution 'discarded' (schema.ex:565) - FOUND on origin/main.

stage-verb wiring pattern (manifest cli_commands/0 + register_routes/1 + controller action + generic CLI dispatch + generic MCP bridge; charter D7/D8 read: no bridgeShadowedIDs entry for stage) - FOUND.
The 4 allowlist copies and the offset-drop site; the ready-offset protective-test template at tasks_controller_test.exs:148 - FOUND.

Reachability + double-guard Two sub-attacks. (1) If close/move/sweeper all use raw Repo.update_all, only user-facing patch/stage are gated - enough? YES: the threat model is a forged done/in_progress via blind patch and convention-only jumps; engine primitives are trusted-by-construction. (2) Cloud-Console-Hardening already shipped a ledger close-guard (cch-w1-ledger-close-guard: /v1/data/mutate refuses a terminal lifecycle_status with no claim/epoch/worker) + cch-w3-task-birth-attribution. S7 must COMPOSE with that guard, not duplicate or fight it. Survey maps what CCH landed so the transition table layers cleanly on top.

Fence + coordination hazards

  • OUR FENCE: api/lib/barkpark/tasks/** (schema/claim/lifecycle/ttl_sweeper/queue/transitions), internal/cli task verbs + manifest, api/test, the tasks-API controller + router for the stage endpoint.
  • OFF-LIMITS: scripts/pds-*, tooling/grip/, cloud/**, api/lib/barkpark_web/live/studio (S5 + prime-chip ceded), felix's exact content/ + tenancy/ + plugins/ files (PRs HELD behind crown freeze).
  • OPEN PR #5473 fix(tasks): guard ClaimFence.verify against non-UUID task_id touches claim_fence.ex - avoid colliding.
  • gr-blk-primary-checkout-reconcile: foreign uncommitted TLV work + untracked internal/taskboard/purpose.go stranded in the primary checkout - do all work in this worktree, never the primary.
  • MERGE-FREEZE: a crown climb is arming; PRs may be HELD briefly. Build and push normally; the lead merges when the freeze lifts.
  • STALE-PREMISE: prove landed-ness by CONTENT; re-verify task ids at L1; use GET /v1/data/query/production/task?filter[parent_id]=<id>, never /v1/tasks?filter[parent_id]= (1/15 correct).

Survey plan (wide net - every question + why)

13 broad Sonnet assignments. Width is cheap now; Digest distills. Each targets a load-bearing assumption or seam the direction rests on.

  • felix-collision-map - exactly which content/ files (esp writer.ex do_create/do_upsert) felix-pristine touched and whether frozen. WHY: decides the S7 enforcement point.
  • writer-seam-reality - read writer.ex do_create/do_upsert: where prev_doc is in scope for type=task lifecycle changes; is an in-fence tasks-side seam viable without blocking engine primitives.
  • engine-bypass-set - enumerate every path that writes lifecycle_status and which use raw update_all vs route through Writer/validation. WHY: proves gate coverage AND that primitives won't be wrongly refused.
  • cch-close-guard-map - read cch-w1/w2/w3: what /v1/data/mutate already refuses for terminal lifecycle_status. WHY: S7 must compose with it.
  • ttl-sweeper-anatomy - the existing lease sweep (advisory lock, CAS-rev, config keys, event emit) so S6's second sweep reuses it exactly.
  • engagement-substrate-check - did S1 land engagement-map validation + resolution 'discarded' + desk_groups thought chip? WHY: what S6/S7 must still add.
  • stage-verb-wiring - end-to-end pattern for a sanctioned task verb (manifest, router, controller, CLI verb, generic MCP bridge). WHY: the stage verb must follow it.
  • claim-broken-truth - is bp task claim actually broken (the :doc_id placeholder defect) or was it CLI staleness now fixed? Reproduce on a fresh open task.
  • spd-b24-blocked-fence - trace claim.ex: can a blocked task be directly claimed; intended-soft vs defect; cost/blast-radius of a true blocking primitive.
  • pagination-offset-bug - reproduce tlv-bl-tasks-ls-offset-broken: where offset is dropped (controller vs query.ex); what test proves the fix.
  • ready-allowlist-dup - every repo-wide copy of ~w(open blocked); cleanest single source.
  • transition-legality-baseline - which of D7's transitions slip through /v1/data/mutate today and which are already blocked. WHY: scopes what the gate must NEWLY refuse.
  • test-harness-landscape - where tasks lifecycle tests live; how to run targeted without DB boot; fixtures for considering/researching; read the prior wave paper's debrief/residue.

Shortest path to seal (named)

  1. This wave: S6 + S7 + spd-b24 ruling + two cheap defects - all with protective tests.
  2. In parallel elsewhere: S5 (Studio board + chat fail-open) by the studio-owning wave.
  3. Then S8 - the capstone: bp-epic-cycle births candidates as considering, stages researching, promotes/discards visibly (Front B). Round-3, after S5/S6/S7 merge.
  4. Then a graded review wave closes the epic. Backlog tlv-bl-* are EXPLICIT non-blocking deferrals per the charter - not required for seal.

DIGEST folded 2026-07-21 - 13 survey reports synthesized, verify fleet designed - STATUS: verifying

Survey digest - what the 13 reports established (L1)

  • Writer-seam is REACHABLE - the sharpest attack is REFUTED. felix-pristine never touched content/writer.ex (git log: last touch 65da9f64d, unrelated pt-w1, already on main); no open PR touches it; no merge-freeze concept ties to it. prev_doc is in scope at writer.ex:126 (do_create_document) and :553 (do_upsert_document), before Document.changeset/Repo.update. S7 enforces at writer.ex - no need to fall back to a tasks-side seam.
  • Engine primitives bypass by construction. 5 sites write lifecycle_status via raw Repo.update_all - close.ex:271, close.ex:437 (cascade_unblock_dependents!), ttl_sweeper.ex:284, claim.ex:316, release.ex:137 - none route through Content.Writer or Tasks.Validation. move/compactor/fence touch rows but never write lifecycle_status; judge.ex never touches the DB. A Writer-seam gate excludes every engine write automatically. No Barkpark.Tasks.Transitions module exists - S7 is greenfield.
  • The mutate door already has TWO merged guards on origin/main: ensure_task_close_is_cas/5 (cch-w1, #5309/515f14fdd) refuses a blind patch INTO terminal (done|cancelled|blocked, mutations.ex:402) unless ifRevisionID is present; ensure_claim_not_dropped/4 (cch-w2, #5435/a893c3821) refuses erasing an existing claim. Both wired at mutations.ex 177/178, 268/269, 312/313, 341/342. The ledger shows these tasks in_progress but git is truth - they are LIVE.
  • GAPS S7 must NEWLY close (the guard inspects the TARGET status only, never the SOURCE): any->in_progress is UNGUARDED (in_progress is not in the terminal set); done->considering / done->open / cancelled->researching are ALL UNGUARDED; a fresh create with lifecycle_status=done bypasses everything (cch-w3, still open/unbuilt, 0/3). The wish's 'REFUSED via patch: any->in_progress' and 'done|cancelled->considering|researching' have ZERO coverage today.
  • bp task claim is NOT broken. The lead's live finding is STALE/DEAD - fixed 5+ weeks ago (0829d68a6, confirmed ancestor of HEAD). A live --dry-run repro builds POST /v1/tasks/<id>/claim with worker in body; all 136 manifest commands have resolvable placeholders. Do NOT cut a claim-fix slice.
  • spd-b24's premise is HALF-WRONG at L1: 'blocked' does NOT hide a task from ready today - a live blocked task (pds-w1-crown-proof) appears in bp task ready. Real gating is blocks-edges + content.dependencies, not the lifecycle label; blocked IS directly claimable via the open|blocked allowlist. Recommendation: intended-soft (document + protective-test the current open/blocked symmetry); a true blocking primitive is a deeper cross-surface (board.ex + ceded S5) change for after S7.
  • ready-allowlist duplication is 4 copies, not 2: queue.ex:35 (attr), claim.ex:26 (attr, used in a guard at :158), queue.ex:91 (raw SQL fragment IN ('open','blocked')), board.ex:1001 (function-guard literal). Zero copies in Go/JS (they render server-resolved strings). The filed tlv-bl-ready-allowlist-consolidation names only 2 - underscoped. Fix stays attribute-shaped (Elixir guards need compile-time literals): @claimable_statuses derived from a new Validation.claimable_statuses/0, mirroring lifecycle_statuses/0.
  • The pagination bug is real and TWO-layered: GET /v1/tasks (TasksController.index/2, tasks_controller.ex:227-263) never reads or applies offset (base query has limit but no offset; params['offset'] is never referenced), AND the task.ls manifest (plugins/tasks.ex) declares no offset flag. task.ready is the exact working template (manifest offset flag + ready/2 parse/clamp/apply). doc.query pages correctly. The fix must touch BOTH tasks_controller.ex and plugins/tasks.ex.
  • S6 substrate is fully landed: engagement validated as an optional top-level map (validation.ex:117, claim-map precedent, no epochs); desk 'thinking' chip (schema.ex:78, in [considering,researching]); 'discarded' resolution option (schema.ex:565, UNENFORCED). S6 build = a SECOND sweep in ttl_sweeper.ex reusing the advisory-lock + select-then-recheck + CAS-rev pattern, NO epoch machinery, lapsing researching->considering + clearing stale engagement, emitting task.engagement_lapsed, new config key task_engagement_ttl_seconds (default 900). tlv-s6 already carries this recipe verbatim.
  • Test harness: mix test is safe + fast on this box (~3s for a DataCase file against the already-live Postgres); ONLY mix phx.server OOMs, never mix test. No shared task fixture exists - mk_task!/3 is copy-pasted across 22+ files. considering/researching appear in NO engine code yet; S6/S7 tests will be the FIRST committed tests that create those rows.

  • writer.ex prev_doc sites (do_create:118/126, do_upsert:545/553) and validate_task_kind ordering (runs on attrs BEFORE prev_doc fetch) - FOUND.
  • Engine bypass set across all 8 tasks/ files (which write lifecycle_status vs which only touch the row) - FOUND.
  • cch-w1/w2 merged guard code, line numbers, wiring, terminal set, and the create/createIfNotExists structural exemption - FOUND (git show origin/main).

Coverage map - checked & NOT FOUND (decisions-in-waiting + unreached corners)

  • NOT PROVEN BY RUNNING: no surveyor RAN mutate_controller_test.exs for a green baseline, nor executed a probe proving the escape-hatch/gap behavior. Every 'refused/allowed today' claim is a static read of merged code + prior stamped evidence. Verify must RUN it (distrust vacuous green).

If prev_doc is pre-merged, the gate reads new==new and never fires - this MUST be proven before the seam is trusted.
  • GREENFIELD: no stage/2 controller action and no Barkpark.Tasks.stage primitive exist - S7 builds from scratch.
  • OUT OF FENCE / UNCHECKED: web/react and api/lib/barkpark_web/live/studio for additional lifecycle_status write paths (ceded to the studio wave).
  • CHARTER PARTIALLY READ: .claude/workflows/bp-task-lifecycle-visibility-charter.md was fully opened only by stage-verb-wiring (D7/D8). Whether a D-number rules on compose-vs-supersede between Transitions.legal?/2 and the cch guards is unconfirmed - verify reads it.
  • NEW BACKLOG: outcome.resolution 'discarded' is advertised in the schema manifest but enforced NOWHERE (close.ex never reads outcome.resolution) - filed this wave as a child task.

Contradictions the Decide phase must resolve

  • Lead note 'claim broken' vs survey live-repro 'claim works' -> survey wins at L1; verify re-runs the dry-run to seal it. No claim slice.
  • spd-b24 filed premise 'blocked hides from ready' vs live 'it does not' -> rescope the slice to document + protective-test the current open/blocked symmetry BEFORE any builder touches its acceptance criteria.
  • Direction's 'compose with the cch-w1 guard' vs the ifRevisionID escape hatch (any->done SUCCEEDS with just a correct rev today) -> S7 likely SUPERSEDES the terminal-target branch rather than layering on it, else the escape hatch reopens the hole the table intends to close. Verify establishes exact current behavior first.

Verify fleet - the last look (each assignment names what it RUNS as proof)

  • s7-seam-proof [opus, worktree]: Does content/mutations.ex pre-merge the new lifecycle_status before Writer, so writer.ex prev_doc still holds the OLD value at do_create/do_upsert? PROVE with a scratch DataCase test that patches lifecycle_status and asserts prev_doc.content holds the prior value at the gate site. RUNS: mix test on a scratch probe in a worktree.
  • mutate-guard-baseline [opus, worktree]: Green baseline + PROVE current mutate-door behavior. RUNS: mix test test/barkpark_web/controllers/mutate_controller_test.exs, then a scratch test proving (a) blind open->done refused w/o rev, (b) open->done SUCCEEDS with ifRevisionID, (c) any->in_progress ALLOWED, (d) done->considering ALLOWED. Read charter D7/D8 for a compose-vs-supersede ruling. Scopes exactly what S7 must newly refuse.
  • claim-and-manifest [sonnet]: Kill the stale lead note. RUNS: bp task claim <fresh-open-id> probe --dry-run (confirm resolved URL) + a bp capabilities placeholder sweep. No prod mutation.
  • offset-repro [sonnet, worktree]: PROVE the bug is real and the test can fail. RUNS: mix test the existing ready-offset describe (green), then a scratch test asserting GET /v1/tasks?parent=<phase>&limit=2&offset=2 is disjoint from offset=0 - must FAIL on current code (offset ignored).
  • allowlist-feasibility [sonnet, worktree]: Confirm 4 copies + PROVE the single-source compiles. RUNS: add Validation.claimable_statuses/0 + @claimable_statuses in queue.ex/claim.ex in a worktree, mix compile (compile-time attr-from-cross-module-function) + targeted claim/queue test still green. Flag board.ex:1001 + queue.ex:91 SQL as scope the filed task misses.
  • s6-harness-baseline [sonnet]: Prove the harness S6 reuses is green. RUNS: mix test test/barkpark/tasks/ttl_sweeper_test.exs; confirm engagement validation landed (validation.ex:117) and no engagement sweep exists yet.
